item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Top Iranian Negotiator Suggests Further Peace Talks Are Possible
item.summary: Vice President JD Vance said Sunday that a marathon session of negotiations between the United States and Iran had failed to immediately produce an agreement to end the war.

item.title: In Pakistan Talks, Iran Saw a U.S. Trying to Dictate, Not Negotiate
item.summary: Iran sees American demands as reaching far beyond what it achieved in war. Tehran is gambling that it can withstand further bombardment more than Washington is willing to sustain economic chaos, experts say.

item.title: Inside Tyre, a Lebanese City Bombarded by Israel
item.summary: In Tyre, a city on Lebanon’s coast, near-daily bombardments by Israel have killed and injured civilians, and left many searching for shelter.

item.title: Israel Launches New Attacks in Lebanon, Days Ahead of Rare Direct Talks
item.summary: Israel’s campaign targeting Hezbollah in Lebanon has been a source of tension in the U.S.-Iran cease-fire. Israeli and Lebanese officials plan to meet for rare talks in Washington this week.

item.title: Netanyahu Says War With Iran is ‘Not Yet Over’
item.summary: In a televised address, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel sought to placate critics at home who say the war failed to achieve its goals.

item.title: The ‘Islamabad Peace Talks’ Are Over. What Now for Pakistan?
item.summary: With the U.S. and Iranian delegations gone from Islamabad and the cease-fire uncertain, Pakistan faces its own economic and diplomatic challenges.

item.title: U.K. Puts Chagos Islands Deal on Hold Following Criticism From Trump
item.summary: The plan to give Mauritius formal control of the islands, home to a U.S.-British military base, was called “an act of great stupidity” by President Trump.

item.title: The Escalating Global A.I. Arms Race
item.summary: China, the U.S., Russia and others have ramped up their contest over artificial-intelligence-backed weapons and military systems. The buildup has been compared to the dawn of the nuclear weapons age.

item.title: What Now? Vance Leaves Iran Talks Without a Deal.
item.summary: The lack of a breakthrough after 21 hours of negotiations leaves the Trump administration facing several unpalatable options.

item.title: Rejected by Dozens of Emergency Rooms: South Korea’s Medical Crisis
item.summary: Hundreds of patients every year have trouble finding emergency care, even though the country has a world-class medical system. For some, the delays have been fatal.
